The major components of the Work include: Removal of the existing deteriorated dock structure Concrete dock beams and decking (approximately 17,600 SF) Floating dock system (approximately 1,908 SF) Gangways (8 total) connecting fixed and floating dock elements Dock substructure and Marine earthwork Dockside electrical systems including power pedestals, conduit, wiring, and LED luminaires Pump-out unit for vessel waste management Potable water piping and distribution Sanitary force main Recreational amenities including benches, bicycle racks, dock ladders, and Hoyer lift Site clearing, erosion control, stormwater management, and site restoration
